# Minimal RuoYi-Vue-Pro runtime bridge source

This portfolio archive retains only the upstream enum required by
`backend/ruoyi-runtime-bridge`, together with the pinned-source record and MIT
license:

- `LICENSE.upstream`
- `UPSTREAM.lock`
- `yudao-framework/yudao-common/src/main/java/cn/iocoder/yudao/framework/common/enums/WebFilterOrderEnum.java`

The operational source repository contained a larger pinned upstream snapshot.
It is intentionally omitted here to keep the portfolio focused and to avoid
inflating first-party source counts. The retained file remains third-party MIT
code and is not claimed as original work.
